snippet.title: Dragon's Dog mother
snippet.description:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.adventure.odysseyringforeign

Dragon's Dog mother is a dark fantasy open world ARPG. The game has a wide world and rich dungeons for players to explore. Hundreds of props and weapons can be explored and experienced. Various bosses such as rock giants, dark knights, and giant rats and ghosts can be fought. Moreover, we have superb optimization technology, and low-end equipment can also be used. Can be played smoothly.
The knight wakes up and the kingdom has been destroyed.
He opened his eyes wide and looked at the scene in front of him. A sense of fear came over him. He rushed to the ruins in the distance and found his dead wife inside.
He hugged his wife helplessly and cried bitterly.
At this time, a mysterious man in a black robe suddenly appeared behind him, smiled coldly, and told him, "I can turn back time and space and let you go back to the past, but you have to promise to help me bring the Ring of Versailles to him." Sky Goddess".
The knight was stunned for a few seconds. After wiping away his tears, he didn't ask any more questions. He just answered him firmly: "Take me back!"
